description: This file contains tests for the 'channels' configuration status output, specifically for verifying the display of plugin status, configuration, and secret resolution states in a command-line interface. It sets up various mock plugins and tests different scenarios related to plugin configuration and secret availability.

methods.name: function registerSingleTestPlugin(pluginId: string, plugin: ChannelPlugin) { registerSingleTestPlugin
methods.description: Registers a test plugin with a given plugin ID and plugin instance, updating the active plugin registry for testing purposes.

methods.name: async function formatLocalStatusSummary( formatLocalStatusSummary
methods.description: Generates a status summary string for a given configuration, focusing on local mode, optionally including source configuration details.

methods.name: function unresolvedTokenAccount() { unresolvedTokenAccount
methods.description: Creates a mock token account object representing an unresolved token account.

methods.name: function tokenOnlyPluginConfig() { tokenOnlyPluginConfig
methods.description: Provides a mock plugin configuration with methods related to token account management.

methods.name: function makeUnavailableTokenPlugin(): ChannelPlugin { makeUnavailableTokenPlugin
methods.description: Creates a mock ChannelPlugin instance representing a token-only plugin with unavailable secret.

methods.name: function makeResolvedTokenPlugin(): ChannelPlugin { makeResolvedTokenPlugin
methods.description: Creates a mock ChannelPlugin instance representing a token-only plugin with resolved secret info.

methods.name: function makeResolvedTokenPluginWithoutInspectAccount(): ChannelPlugin { makeResolvedTokenPluginWithoutInspectAccount
methods.description: Creates a mock ChannelPlugin instance representing a token-only extension without inspectAccount capability.

methods.name: function makeUnavailableHttpSlackPlugin(): ChannelPlugin { makeUnavailableHttpSlackPlugin
methods.description: Creates a mock ChannelPlugin instance for Slack with an unavailable signing secret.

methods.name: function expectResolvedTokenStatusSummary( expectResolvedTokenStatusSummary
methods.description: Asserts that the status summary contains expected token-related status indicators, optionally excluding unavailable token lines.
